signals.signal: Postbank opened 'Postbank Next', its first next-generation phygital office, at XOPark (Bulgaria's largest retail park), on 14/05/2026. The layout is explicitly zoned: a Digital Express self-service zone for standard banking operations, a Digital zone, an Interactive zone, an Assisted zone for complex decisions and a dedicated Video Consultation zone with remote connection to specialist experts. The customer journey starts with a greeter, passes through self-service, and only reaches a banker if needed - 'without requiring every operation to be performed by an employee'.
signals.source_name: Investor.bg - Postbank sets the direction of modern banking with Postbank Next
signals.implies: This is a branch-transformation template that has to be replicated across a 185-retail-branch network: cash recyclers/TCRs and self-service kiosks in the Digital Express zone, VTM/video-teller hardware and software in the video-consultation zone, plus the branch-services and managed-services wrap around both. Directly addressable by Printec cash automation + self-service + managed services.
signals.likelihood: High - pilot already open, bank says innovations roll out in stages over the following months
signals.followup: Establish which OEM supplies the Postbank Next self-service devices and who supplies the video-consultation platform, and how many Next branches are planned for 2026-27.

signals.signal: On 28/04/2026, alongside its 35th anniversary, Postbank launched a full rebrand - new logo, new strategic positioning - explicitly covering the physical branches, digital banking channels, mobile apps, corporate websites and all official communication material, and announcing a 'network of next-generation Postbank NEXT spaces integrating digital technologies, self-service zones and video consultation capabilities'. Scope, branch count and capex were deliberately not quantified; the bank said innovations would be presented in stages over the following months.
signals.source_name: Investor.bg / Capital.bg - Postbank meets its 35th anniversary with a renewed visual identity and new strategic positioning
signals.implies: A rebrand that reaches every physical branch is the single most reliable trigger for branch refurbishment and hardware replacement. Combined with the euro changeover (all ATMs re-certified for euro on 01/01/2026), Bulgaria has two simultaneous reasons to touch every device in the estate in 2026-27.
signals.followup: Ask Postbank procurement for the branch-refurbishment schedule and whether device replacement is bundled into the rebrand programme.

signals.entity: Eurobank Group / Innovation Investment Fund S.a r.l. (Luxembourg)
signals.signal: On 20/05/2026 Eurobank Group's Luxembourg-based Innovation Investment Fund S.a r.l. took a strategic stake (size undisclosed) in CSoft, a Bulgarian technology company specialising in CORE BANKING SYSTEMS and digital solutions, covering digital channels, risk management, regulatory reporting and operational efficiency. The group and CSoft describe a long-standing collaboration; the capital is earmarked for automation, data-driven decisioning, integration into complex system estates, product-portfolio expansion and international expansion.
signals.source_name: 24chasa.bg - Luxembourg-based Innovation Fund, owned by Eurobank Group, invests in CSoft (advertorial); also listed in Postbank's own news feed
signals.implies: Eurobank is now a shareholder in a regional banking-software vendor whose product lines - digital channels, risk, regulatory reporting - overlap Printec's software adjacency. Expect group-internal preference for CSoft on software, which narrows the addressable software spend inside the c.EUR 730m envelope and pushes Printec toward the hardware/cash-cycle and managed-services side where CSoft does not play.
signals.likelihood: Medium-High - captive-vendor dynamics usually build over 12-24 months
signals.followup: Profile CSoft (Varna-based, reported 200-strong team target): product list, existing bank clients, and whether it has any ATM/self-service software.

signals.signal: On 16/07/2026 Postbank launched fully in-app customer registration in the Postbank App: remote identification, automated checks, electronic signing of all documents and NFC scanning of the national ID card for document/identity verification, ending with an active current account, a digital debit card, activated mobile+internet banking and a chosen package programme - in minutes, with no branch visit and no paper.
signals.source_name: Postbank - 'Only minutes to everyday banking with Postbank' (own news page)
signals.implies: A production-grade eKYC/digital-onboarding stack with NFC eID reading is now live at the group's Bulgarian bank. For Printec this is both competitive intelligence (the slot is filled in BG) and a reference point to sell the same capability into Cyprus, where the merged entity still has two customer bases to re-KYC.
signals.followup: Identify the vendor behind Postbank's remote identification / NFC eID reading and e-signing components.

signals.signal: FY2025 results deck (26/02/2026) raises the Cyprus acquisition synergy target to EUR 140m fully phased by 2027, of which EUR 85m is still to be captured; capture schedule 2025 40% / 2026 70% / 2027 100%. Eurobank Ltd is #1 in Cypriot deposits (41% share) and #2 in loans (34%). Baseline carried EUR 120m by 2027 - this is a materially higher and harder number.
signals.implies: A larger synergy number with a 2027 hard stop forces fast physical consolidation of the two Cypriot estates: cash automation/recyclers to take teller cost out of 50 retail branches + 21 centres, plus managed services on a merged ATM fleet.
signals.likelihood: High - on a published capture schedule
signals.followup: Obtain the Eurobank Ltd (CY) 2025 annual report for the merged ATM/Cash360 device count and the OEM behind it.

signals.signal: The bank's own merger FAQ confirms the Cypriot entity has NOT yet moved to a single core: it refers to 'the phase when systems are consolidated and transitioned to the new central banking system', at which point account numbers linked to investment portfolios may be renumbered. A unified Table of Commissions and Charges took effect 03/11/2025; stage 1 of the merger added seven ex-Hellenic branches to the ex-Eurobank Cyprus network; ex-Eurobank Cyprus cards withdraw at ex-Hellenic ATMs subject to a EUR 500 per-transaction cap; digital wallets and the Mple Rewards scheme are still not extended across the combined base.
signals.source_name: Eurobank Limited (CY) - Integration FAQ, Common Customers
signals.implies: A pending core-banking cutover in Cyprus is the classic window for everything that hangs off it: ATM/self-service switch and driving software, HSM/key migration, transaction monitoring and AML re-certification, card re-issuance and eKYC on the merged base. The EUR 500 cross-estate ATM cap and the unfinished wallet/loyalty extension are visible evidence the channel layer is still two systems.
signals.followup: Identify the target core platform and the ATM-switch/driving vendor for the merged Cypriot entity.

signals.signal: The Cypriot bulk-cash layer is now reported as THIRTEEN Cash360 coin machines and FIVE Cash360 note machines at selected branches in Nicosia, Limassol and Larnaca (was 11 coin + 5 note in Oct-2022), with the coin-deposit routing threshold cut from over EUR 200 to over EUR 100 - i.e. more cash pushed to the machines. Separately, on 22/10/2024 the bank launched unmanned 'automated service points' - upgraded locations equipped only with advanced ATMs plus Cash 360 machines, open 24/7 - at addresses in Nicosia (Makarios III), Limassol (Agia Fylaxis, Gladstonos), Larnaca (Zenon Kitionos) and Paphos (Geroskipou).
signals.source_name: Cyprus Mail - Hellenic Bank launches new automated service points; Cyprus Mail - Hellenic ushering in a new era in banking services
signals.implies: Eighteen bulk-cash machines for the largest bank in Cyprus is a very thin layer, and the bank is actively pushing MORE cash onto it (threshold cut to EUR 100) and building unmanned sites that depend on it entirely. That is a concrete, sized cash-automation gap: recyclers, coin/note deposit machines, and the managed-services contract to keep unmanned sites available.
signals.likelihood: High - unmanned-site model already live and expanding
signals.followup: Confirm the current Cash360 count and the OEM (Cash360 is a service brand, not an OEM name) via the Eurobank Ltd charges table or a branch visit.

signals.signal: Banking Forward event (29/06/2026) disclosed the operating baseline behind the c.EUR 1bn 2025-28 digital envelope: 96% of transactions done digitally, 61% via the mobile app, 50% of applications/channels already on cloud, 1,600+ digital & technology professionals in 30+ cross-functional teams, 100+ new digital capabilities in six months, 574m annual e-/mobile-banking logins, 1m+ digital transactions a day, 33% of banking products acquired fully digitally in H1-2026 (+160% vs H1-2025), 1,500+ staff through 17,000+ hours of AI/ML training. Named internal toolset: EVA, myEVA, GenAI Factory, Digital Brain. Mastercard partnership expanded (Priceless).
signals.source_name: Capital.gr - Eurobank: EUR 1bn investment in digital banking with AI at the tip
signals.implies: 96% digital / 61% mobile means the residual physical work is cash and identity. Printec's entry is not the AI layer (EY/Microsoft/Accenture/Fairfax and now CSoft are inside) but the regulated plumbing around it: eKYC/digital onboarding for the 33%-and-rising digital acquisition, AML/transaction monitoring and HSM/security for agentic actions on live money.
signals.followup: Locate the primary Eurobank press release for the 29/06/2026 Banking Forward event; the press-office index only exposes ~9 recent items with no pagination.

signals.signal: 1Q2026 pack (07/05/2026) gives primary, audited-basis network data: 556 branches and 12,405 headcount at 31/03/2026, down from 562 / 12,408 at 31/12/2025. Accessibility disclosure adds a rare device datapoint: 3 more ATMs were made wheelchair-accessible in 1Q26 'reaching 143 in total', and '184 branches (69%) are wheelchair accessible through fixed or removable ramps' - the 69% denominator implies a c.267-branch perimeter (most plausibly the Greek retail network). NOTE a contradiction to log: the FY2025 deck states '144 ATMs are wheelchair accessible' at 31/12/2025, which cannot reconcile with 143 after a +3 quarter.
signals.implies: Eurobank still refuses to publish a total ATM count - the accessibility disclosures are the only device-level numbers it releases. The slow branch drift (-6 in a quarter) and a c.267-branch Greek perimeter is the sizing basis for any in-branch recycler/TCR pursuit in Greece.
signals.followup: Reconcile 143 vs 144 wheelchair-accessible ATMs across the FY25 and 1Q26 decks; use the 2Q26 pack as tiebreaker.

signals.signal: FY2025 deck 'SEE operations key figures - 4Q25' gives Bulgaria 185 RETAIL branches plus 11 business/private banking centres at 31/12/2025 (assets EUR 13,580m, deposits EUR 11,045m, CAD 22.1%). The baseline's 193-branch figure (182 retail + 11 centres) is superseded by this issuer-primary split.
signals.source_name: Eurobank Holdings FY2025 Results Presentation (PDF), SEE operations key figures - 4Q25
signals.implies: 185 retail branches is the denominator for the Postbank NEXT rollout and for any recycler/TCR density calculation in Bulgaria - a slightly larger physical footprint than the baseline assumed.
signals.followup: Get a 2026 primary ATM count for Postbank; the >450 figure remains unverified on postbank.bg.

signals.signal: Postbank was selected on 22/06/2026 to the European Commission's Advisory Forum under the EU AI Act, after a ~10-month selection from more than 700 applicant organisations worldwide; it is the ONLY bank from Central and Eastern Europe in the ~170-member forum, which also includes OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral AI, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, IBM, Hugging Face and Qualcomm.
signals.source_name: Postbank - Postbank selected as a member of the European Commission's AI Advisory Forum (own news page)
signals.implies: Postbank is positioning as the group's AI-governance centre of excellence. Any Printec product touching AI-assisted decisioning (AML scoring, transaction monitoring, fraud) sold into this group will face EU AI Act conformity questions from an unusually well-informed buyer - and conformity evidence becomes a differentiator rather than paperwork.
signals.followup: Prepare AI Act conformity documentation for any AI-bearing Printec module offered to Eurobank Group.

signals.signal: Postbank runs a programme of 100+ AI projects out of two dedicated AI development centres (operational since 2025): 12 projects fully implemented, 8 more in flight, 105,000+ employee-hours of productivity gained, 420,000+ hours of customer time saved, AI+RPA live in 24 departments, 30%+ service and 70%+ process-efficiency improvement. 'EVA AI Voice Bot' took over call-centre handling from early 2026, 24/7. 95%+ of all transactions are online; mobile transfer volume +113% y/y; digital wallet use +127%.
signals.source_name: Investor.bg - Postbank accelerates its digital transformation with a programme of 100+ AI projects
signals.implies: Bulgaria is the group's automation testbed and it is software-led and largely in-house. The hardware corollary: with 95%+ of transactions already online, the 185-branch estate exists mainly for cash and onboarding - i.e. recycler/TCR density and eKYC, not more counters.
signals.followup: Confirm whether the two AI centres are staffed in-house or by an external SI.

signals.signal: Group IT & Digital investment plan re-verified directly from the FY2025 deck: 'Group IT and Digital investments 2026-28: c.EUR 730m', with IT CapEx of EUR 187m in FY25 rising to c.EUR 225m (FY26E), c.EUR 245m (FY27E) and c.EUR 260m (FY28E); the Greece/SEE split moves 60/40 (FY25) to 75/25 (FY26E), 70/30 (FY27E) and back to 60/40 (FY28E). The same deck contains the only ATM-fleet datapoint the issuer publishes: '100% of ATMs feature voice guidance, while 144 ATMs are wheelchair accessible'.
signals.implies: The SEE share dips to c.25% in FY26E before recovering to c.40% by FY28E - roughly EUR 56m of non-Greek IT spend in 2026 rising to c.EUR 104m in 2028. Bulgarian and Cypriot hardware/managed-services pursuits should be timed for the FY27-28 back end of the plan, not FY26.
signals.followup: Watch the 2Q2026 pack for any revision to the c.EUR 730m envelope or the geography split.

signals.signal: 2Q2026 / 1H2026 results were still unpublished at 17:20 EEST on 30/07/2026, the announced publication date (conference call 18:00 EEST the same day). All plausible PDF paths under /oikonomika-apotelesmata/2026/2q-2026/, /1h-2026/ and /h1-2026/ returned 404, and the IR results index still listed 9M2025 as the latest entry.
signals.source_name: Eurobank - Financial Results index (IR) plus direct PDF path probes
signals.implies: The 1H2026 pack is where an updated branch/headcount count, the SEE operations key figures and any revision to the c.EUR 730m IT envelope will land. It must be re-scraped before the weekly pack is finalised.
signals.followup: Re-fetch the 2Q2026 press release and presentation on 31/07/2026 and extract the SEE operations key figures slide.

coverage_notes: Full fresh pass (the earlier attempt in this same run left only a .md, no JSON checkpoint, so the structured rows were rebuilt from primary sources). Angles worked: (1) issuer-primary PDFs - FY2025 and 1Q2026 results decks downloaded and text-extracted locally with pdfminer into a private directory (a concurrent agent had overwritten a shared scratchpad filename, so everything was re-downloaded and re-verified); (2) the eurobank.com.cy domain, which is NOT Cloudflare-blocked, giving the Eurobank Limited merger integration FAQ - the best primary evidence that the Cypriot core cutover is still ahead; (3) postbank.bg's own news feed at /en/about-us/news/, a path the previous notes had written off as client-rendered, which surfaced the AI Act Advisory Forum membership and the NFC in-app onboarding launch; (4) Bulgarian-language press (investor.bg, 24chasa, capital.bg, economic.bg) for Postbank NEXT, the rebrand and the CSoft investment; (5) Greek press for the 29/06/2026 Banking Forward event; (6) Cyprus Mail archive for the ex-Hellenic Cash360 estate and the 2024 automated service points; (7) Claude-in-Chrome escalation for eurobank.cy after curl-with-desktop-UA still returned 403. GENUINE GAPS: Eurobank still publishes NO total ATM count for any country - the only device numbers it discloses are the accessibility ones (100% voice-guided, 143/144 wheelchair-accessible), so all fleet sizing remains inferential. The ATM/self-service OEM is UNIDENTIFIED in all three markets (Greece, Postbank BG, Eurobank Ltd CY) and 'Cash 360' is a service brand, not a vendor name - this remains a standing task. Postbank's >450-ATM figure could not be re-verified on postbank.bg in 2026. The number of Greek phygital / Future Branch conversions is not published anywhere primary (the Green Brand Awards entry is qualitative only). 2Q2026/1H2026 results were still not out at 17:34 EEST on the publication date, so the freshest network counts remain 1Q2026.

Workaround for CY content: www.eurobank.com.cy (ex-Eurobank Cyprus domain) serves 200 to plain curl. eurobankholdings.gr/en/... 301s to eurobank.gr/el/omilos. eurobank.com.cy/sitemap.xml returns homepage HTML, not XML. Eurobank press-office index exposes only ~9 recent items with no pagination, so the 29/06/2026 Banking Forward release is unreachable. postbank.bg news IS reachable at /en/about-us/news/ (the older /bg-BG/Za-nas/News path is client-rendered and the /en/Za-nas/News/2026/05/... deep links 404).
